notes.title: Update v0.9.6
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,  [/p][p]Thank you so much for your feedback and we're thrilled with how much everyone's enjoying the game! Please keep the feedback coming as it helps make a better game. Please be sure to share any bugs you encounter on the Steam forums, below, or in the discord!   [/p][p][/p][p][b]FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed Tomes not being able to block[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed Steal no longer working on all monsters after 10 Stealing Attempts during the same run[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed being able to get dungeon completion achievements when running away before the boss fight[/p][/*][*][p](JAPANESE) Fixed "Current Floor" counter and other text displays[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the dice button at the bottom left of the Edit Character menu being able to change your race and reset your character back to level 1[/p][/*][*][p] Fixed your name being set to "Hero" if you didnt input or randomize your name atleast once[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]CHANGES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Changed sound effects of Axe Abilities "Hungry Chop" and "Hack And Slash"[/p][/*][*][p]Auto Save Message now appears in the proper Language you choose, or in your device's language[/p][/*][*][p]Publisher and Developer logo sounds now honor your Audio settings[/p][/*][*][p]Monster's Crit Chance stats are no longer affected by the Monster Strength setting[/p][/*][*][p]Encounter Rate and Treasure Floor dungeon upgrades can no longer be chosen in Boss Dungeons, if youve already added points into those upgrades, consider Resetting to get your points back[/p][/*][*][p]Can now see your current skill level in Ability Tooltips[/p][/*][*][p](ANDROID ONLY) Hid some unrelated options such as Fullscreen mode and Cursor settings[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]MORE FIXES TO COME[/b][/p][p][/p][p]A non-steam version and an Android version can be downloaded on itch.io: [url="https://renoki.itch.io/dragaea-idle"]https://renoki.itch.io/dragaea-idle[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to wishlist the main game and share the game with your friends, every little bit helps us make a better game![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712380/Legends_of_Dragaea_Idle_Dungeons/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Until next time![/p]

notes.title: Update v0.9.5
notes.content:
[p]Hey everyone,

Please keep the feedback coming as it helps make a better game. Here's Update v0.9.5. Please be sure to share any bugs you encounter on the Steam forums, below, or in the discord!


[b]FIXES[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed being able to stack Status Effects durations [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Revitalize ability removing all Status Effects instead of only the Negative ones [/p][/*][*][p]Changed the Dodge Icon -Can now leave during ambushes, but still counts as a loss. [/p][/*][*][p]Properly translated Notes menu -Fixed status effects not clearing properly after dungeoning [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some Quest Stories having blank pages of text [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed "Junk" achievement not completing when using quicksell [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Damage Calculations for multi hit abilities like Foxfire and Tornado. Attack bonuses would compound for each hit, resulting in the next hit doing triple damage than the last hit with Black Ring equipped. [/p][/*][*][p]Increased the maximum amount of Ability Power/Damage of Abilities to 999,999,999 from 999,999. Dealing more than 999,999 damage will print out as "1.2M" [/p][/*][*][p](ANDROID ONLY) game now remembers screen rotation between start ups[/p][/*][/list][p]A non-steam version and an Android version can be downloaded on itch.io: [url="https://renoki.itch.io/dragaea-idle"]https://renoki.itch.io/dragaea-idle[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to wishlist the main game and share the game with your friends, every little bit helps us make a better game![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712380/Legends_of_Dragaea_Idle_Dungeons/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p][p]Until next time![/p]

notes.title: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons Prelude is now LIVE!
notes.content: [p]Hey everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]The game is now live! Go play it![/p][p][/p][p]Please give it a review as every review really helps us out! For a preview for what the new prelude holds check out the previous announcement here: [dynamiclink href="https://steamcommunity.com/games/3730300/announcements/detail/547871324002846665"][/dynamiclink] [/p][p]Some things to note. We'll be deactivating the demo on the main game's store page so if you want to continue that save you can pick up the v0.4 demo below. In addition we have the v0.9 of the android version you can try out.[/p][p][url="https://renoki.itch.io/dragaea-idle"]https://renoki.itch.io/dragaea-idle[/url][/p][p][/p][p]Please note that stats and effects may change between the prelude and the full game. Please visit the discord or post in the discussion forums if you encounter any bugs, want to suggest new features, or have any feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Regarding feedback, some things that were suggested did not yet make it in due to time. If your suggestion has not made it in, please post it again![/p][p][/p][p]We'll have more news on the main game really soon! You can wishlist it below. [/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712380/Legends_of_Dragaea_Idle_Dungeons/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Take it easy, all! And enjoy![/p]

notes.title: Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons Prelude is coming September 18th!
notes.content:
[p]Hey all! [/p][p][/p][p]We've got some exciting news! [i]Legends of Dragaea: Idle Dungeons Prelude[/i] is releasing September 18th, 2025 at 5AM PST. So what does that mean? We got a bunch of new features, quality of life fixes, and tons of content for you to try out! [/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629959/49035d696bdc10d28bfd8a67b5ead29717cce91a.png"][/img][/p][p]This is but a small snippet but the most important feature we have is that [b]achievements and save data will carry forward to the full release[/b]. That means you'll be able to carry over all your progress when the full game unlocks![/p][p][/p][list][*][p]Save Data and Achievements Carry Over To Full Game[/p][/*][*][p]Gamble Shop [/p][/*][*][p]Unique Legendaries [/p][/*][*][p]Achievements [/p][/*][*][p]Repeatable quests [/p][/*][*][p]Improved beastiary [/p][/*][*][p]Treasure floors and boss chests [/p][/*][*][p]Mimics [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked menus [/p][/*][*][p]Balance overhaul[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629959/c6f7c24ddd429e38e66092ed21592baeff86a4ae.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629959/680da83900d4dc5a36e7126f2fb96844b56fe280.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629959/c2a8eb498d400e7af6b30103b39c7b6de62f0751.png"][/img][/p][p]Please note that stats and effects may change between the prelude and the full game. Please visit the discord or post in the discussion forums if you encounter any bugs, want to suggest new features, or have feedback![/p][p][/p][p]Be sure to wishlist the prelude and main game if you haven't already as that really helps us out a ton!

[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2712380/Legends_of_Dragaea_Idle_Dungeons/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]We can't wait to get it into your hands![/p][p][/p][p]Take it easy, all![/p]
